hypotheses.rationale: Day 8 (Tuesday) shows a weekday wake-up at 08:17, consistent with the Day 0/7 pattern (~07:30-08:20). The midday activity (11:58) involves a non-work object, and the afternoon activity (13:18) is leisure/household, reinforcing the absence of remote work indicators during core hours. The distinct weekday/weekend wake-up split remains the strongest discriminator.

Still possible if the resident works from home but keeps all work objects hidden or in a separate room not monitored. However, the lack of any 'work' object movement during the day (unlike the clear 'return home' signal on Day 1) makes this increasingly unlikely compared to the 9-5 hypothesis.
Contradicted by consistent early morning activity on Day 8 (08:17) and the clear weekday/weekend distinction in wake-up times. No evidence of night activity or late departures.
